description: Opportunity knocks! First time on the market in over 40 years, and one of the best priced homes currently available in one of the most desirable neighborhoods you can find. This cosmetic fixer sits at the end of a quiet cul de sac, south of Ventura Blvd, on a large 1/2 acre lot. This home is perfect for a family who is not afraid to roll up their sleeves and complete their vision in an amazing neighborhood. As you approach the large double doors at the front entry of this home you will see the huge amount of potential and curb appeal that this home presents. Once you walk in you will find an open easy flowing floor plan with high ceilings + a large bedroom downstairs conveniently located off the direct access garage and laundry room. The kitchen has been updated and features a beautiful granite counter top, double ovens, & large stainless steel sink with and large windows which allows for an abundance of natural light. A large dining room and living room is perfect for entertaining. Family and living rooms both have a gas fire place. Upstairs you will find two additional bedrooms plus a primary bedroom with a walk in closet and primary bathroom with walk in shower and dual sinks. Step outside to your huge, lush backyard equipped with an swimming pool and jacuzzi, built in bbq area, covered patio , & large grassy area for the kids to play or even build an ADU. This is a home you don't want to miss, and something your family can enjoy for generations to come.
